messages:
Maya: Kickoff for embedded telemetry bundle + marketplace tile. Goal: deliver a self-contained observability tile that works for Hosted, Dedicated, and Private (air-gapped) customers. Sync 2pm PT tomorrow — short standup. @Kevin please own build artifacts and CI.

Kevin: On it. I'll produce: docker image (linux/amd64), airgap tarball with signed manifest, and a signed checksum file. ETA: EOW. Will open a draft PR with the build matrix.

Oliver: Need to lock the telemetry contract early. Propose OTLP over gRPC for traces/metrics in private, OTLP/HTTP option for hosted. Also we should publish a minimal schema for logs (json with request_id/gpu_id). Dashboards: a compact JSON export that we can embed.

Sophia: Confirmed. OTLP/gRPC for private; hosted can accept HTTP. For dashboards: start with three panels — requests/sec, model-latency p50/p95/p99, token-cost per-request. I'll mock the wireframe and copy for the marketplace tile.

Maya: Two risks to escalate: 1) signing keys for airgap artifacts (need KMS/HSM policy) 2) data residency & privacy for marketplace customers. @integrations-bot add legal review.

integrations-bot: Task created: "Telemetry legal review for marketplace tile"; Assignee: Maya; Due: 2026-03-25.

Kevin: Quick collector draft to start discussion:
Kevin: ```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
      http:
exporters:
  otlp/partner:
    endpoint: "https://partner-collector.example:4317"
    tls: true
  file:
    path: "/var/log/redwood/telemetry.ndjson"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces: [otlp]
    metrics: [otlp]
```

Oliver: That looks good as a base. For hosted embedding, we'll add a small JS shim to handle short-lived signed tokens and render an iframe-friendly dashboard. Need a sample iframe payload and CORS rules.

Sophia: I'll produce the dashboard JSON export by EOD and wire up a smoke test that brings up a local collector, sends a sample trace + metric, and validates the dashboard panel values.

Maya: Action items (owners):
- Kevin: build artifacts + CI job + initial PR (#428)
- Oliver: dashboard JSON export + embedding shim + CORS checklist
- Sophia: smoke tests + marketplace listing copy + quickstart docs
- Maya: legal + partner briefing + launch timeline
Weekly sync: Wednesdays 9am PT. Quick daily stand at 2pm PT tomorrow for the initial handoff. :thumbsup: 

Kevin: Quick flag — need guidance on telemetry volume limits for Dedicated customers. Should we ship exporter-level sampling/rate-limiting by default? cc @Oliver

Oliver: Yes, include a default token-bucket sampler and exporter-side rate-limiter with editable thresholds. We'll put conservative defaults and document tuning.

integrations-bot: Checklist update: build artifacts PR opened (#428) by Kevin.

Sophia: Noted. I'll include an opt-in toggle in the marketplace UI to enable higher ingest for customers with committed capacity.

Maya: Great. Let's keep the PRs small and reviewable. If anyone hits legal/KMS blockers ping me immediately. Thanks everyone.
